messages:
sophie.sales: @channel POC with AcmeCorp failing when calling /v1/infer with customer service key. Getting `401 Unauthorized` and body {"error":"invalid_org"}. Customer says key works in other endpoints. curl they used:
```curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-xxxx' -H 'X-ORG-ID: org-acme' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -d '{...}'```
Can someone help? POC due tomorrow.
eli.backend: @sophie.sales can you paste exact response headers? Also which model and region?
sophie.sales: response: `HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized` `x-rw-error: InvalidCredential` `x-rw-tenant: org-acme`. body above. Model `gpt-3.2-fast`, region `us-west-2`.
maya.devops: quick check — is that key a service key bound to org-acme or a project-scoped key? If it's project-scoped you need `X-PROJECT-ID` header or `project` query param.
priya.solutions: had same issue last week — customer created a key in their org but then moved it under a different project. Try `GET /v1/keys/sk-acme-xxxx` (internal) to check binding. @noah.oncall can you run that lookup?
noah.oncall: ran lookup: `sk-acme-xxxx -> owner: org-acme, project: project-zzz, scopes: [inference:read]` — aha scope missing `inference:invoke`. That's why infer returns 401.
sophie.sales: how did that happen? Customer insists they granted full scopes.
eli.backend: sometimes UI creates read-only keys. We can patch scopes server-side but prefer rotate. Short fix: create a temporary org-scoped key with `inference:invoke` and test. Command:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/keys \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"owner":"org-acme","scopes":["inference:invoke"],"ttl":"1h"}'
```
maya.devops: also confirm JWT `aud` claim matches `redwood.v1` and `org_id` claim equals `org-acme`. If they used client creds flow and omitted org claim, validation fails.
priya.solutions: I'll tell customer to rotate and add header `X-ORG-ID` + use new key. Also watch rate-limit headers: `x-rw-ratelimit-remaining`.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy 2026-11-09T14:31:02 completed on us-west-2
sophie.sales: did rotating fix it? Customer trying now...
priya.solutions: customer reports: new key worked, infer responding 200 :tada:
noah.oncall: logged root cause as 'key created with insufficient scopes (read-only)'. Filing follow-up to UX to surface scope selection during key creation.
eli.backend: adding KB snippet: how to debug 401s — check scope, owner binding, headers (X-ORG-ID / X-PROJECT-ID), JWT aud/org claims, and region host. Will add to docs.
sophie.sales: awesome — thanks everyone, saving this thread for the account exec. :lock:
